ticket.title: Centralize the seven-state P9 phase lifecycle in cascade-types and make CLI, engine, daemon, MCP, and app consume it
tasks: Replace the contradictory phase-state definitions with one canonical Rust enum in cascade-types.

Today crates/cascade-core/src/pbd/schema.rs:23-40 defines Opening, Planning, ReadyToBuild, Building, Wrapup, and Archived; apps/cascade-app/src/types/pbd.ts:16 independently declares planning, ready_to_build, building, qa, shipped, and archived; crates/cascade-daemon/src/project_poller.rs:45 stores phase_status as an unchecked String.

Deliver PhaseStatus with the exact serialized values init, planning, ready_to_build, building, verifying, shipped, and archived, plus one transition table and compatibility aliases for opening, ready, build, qa, and wrapup.
